title: Customers
intro: Your customers' WhatsApp messages in one place. Read what came in, answer it, and see what still needs you.

connect.label: WhatsApp number
connect.intro: Connect the WhatsApp Business number your customers write to. The access token is stored encrypted on this desk and never shown again.
connect.phoneNumberIdPlaceholder: From Meta's WhatsApp setup, digits only
connect.disconnectNote: Disconnecting forgets the token and stops new messages. Your conversations stay.
connect.callbackHint: In Meta's webhook settings, paste this URL, enter the verify token set on the server, and subscribe to "messages".
connect.notReady: This server does not have its Meta app secret and verify token yet, so Meta cannot deliver messages to it. Ask whoever runs the server to set them.
connect.sandbox: This app is pointed at a local test server, not at WhatsApp.

list.empty: No conversations yet. Messages your customers send to the connected number appear here.

thread.none: Pick a conversation to read it.

erase.note: Messages are kept until you erase the customer.
erase.confirm: Erase {name} and every message in this thread? This cannot be undone. Do it when the customer asks to be deleted.

window.open: You can reply freely for {hours} h {minutes} min more.
window.openMinutes: You can reply freely for {minutes} min more.
window.closed: The 24-hour window has closed. WhatsApp only allows an approved template message now, which this desk cannot send yet. You can reply as soon as the customer writes again.
window.never: This customer has not written yet, so there is nothing to answer.

errors.connect: WhatsApp did not accept that number and token.
errors.send: WhatsApp did not accept that reply.
errors.notConnected: Connect a WhatsApp number for this desk first.
errors.windowClosed: The 24-hour window has closed, so a free-form reply cannot be sent.
